name: Labrador Retriever
description: An adult golden-yellow Labrador Retriever, a loyal farm companion.

models.description: Rigged, skinned quadruped (19 bones), GLB, no animation - the runtime animation base. Converted from the Blender-built FBX rig.
Unrigged base mesh, as generated by image-to-3d before rigging.

Rigged, skinned quadruped with a 19-bone skeleton (root/spine/neck/head/tail + 4 legs) built and skinned in Blender - static bind pose, no animation. Meshy's meshy_rig tool cannot pose-estimate quadrupeds (confirmed failure), so this was rigged manually via the Blender MCP integration instead.
Rigged model with a hand-keyframed 1-second walk/trot cycle (diagonal gait, 24 frames @ 24fps) baked in.

Rigged model with a hand-keyframed gallop-style run cycle (front/back leg pairing, bigger bob and spine flex, ~0.67s @ 24fps) baked in - this is the default model shown in the asset kit viewer, which auto-plays the animation.

Rigged model with eight clips in one GLB. Walk and Run: hand-keyframed, converted from FBX. Idle (breathing) and IdleTail (tail swish): Animal Animator library, amplified 3-3.5x because the library is tuned for larger rigs, spine pitch sign-corrected for this rig. Sit, Lay, Sleep, Bark: authored in Blender with an IK solver that plants the paws (sit: pelvis drops 24 cm, hind paws tuck forward, front legs straight under the shoulders; lay: sphinx pose; sleep: lay with head down and slow breathing; bark: three head-and-chest snaps). Loop clips have no duplicate end frame.
